$comment: The pieces each campus's Thursday newsletter is built from (README.md, newsletter.json). A newsletter is one subject, one opener, the series line when a series is running, the pieces whose occasion falls 'from' to 'until' days after the send, evergreen pieces to fill it to four, and one closing. A negative 'until' keeps a piece running after its occasion.

pieces.heading: Easter is {eventDate}
pieces.text: Easter is the best Sunday of the year to bring a friend. Find service times for Rock Solid {campus} and plan your visit.

pieces.heading: This is Easter weekend
pieces.text: Services are at {serviceTimes}, with kids programs at every service. Come early, grab a coffee, and save a seat for a friend.

pieces.heading: Christmas Eve at Rock Solid
pieces.text: Join us on {eventDate} for candles, carols, and the story of Jesus' birth. Each service is about an hour, and kids are welcome in the room.

pieces.heading: Help make Christmas Eve warm
pieces.text: We need greeters, parking hosts, and kids volunteers for our busiest night of the year. Pick one service and serve with a friend.

pieces.heading: Thanksgiving food drive
pieces.text: Bring canned goods and boxed stuffing to the Welcome Center before {eventDate}. Our outreach team will deliver every box to families across the Valley.

pieces.heading: Give before the year ends
pieces.text: Gifts made online by {eventDate} count toward this year's giving. Thank you for your generosity all year long.

pieces.heading: Your giving statement
pieces.text: Giving statements for last year go out by email at the end of January. You can also view and print yours anytime online.

pieces.heading: Built on the Rock
pieces.text: For four weeks we're praying and dreaming about a Student Center in Phoenix and new kids rooms at every campus. Read the story and start praying about your part.

pieces.heading: Commitment Sunday is {eventDate}
pieces.text: This Sunday every family is invited to bring a commitment card for Built on the Rock. Whatever you give, we're building something that lasts together.

pieces.heading: Built on the Rock update
pieces.text: Thanks to your gifts, work on the Student Center and the new kids rooms keeps moving. See the latest photos and progress online.

pieces.heading: Baptism Sunday is {eventDate}
pieces.text: Ready to go public with your faith? Sign up online and we'll save you a shirt and a towel.

pieces.heading: Come celebrate baptisms
pieces.text: This Sunday we celebrate people from Rock Solid {campus} who are being baptized. Bring your family and your loudest cheer.

pieces.heading: New here? Start at Starting Point
pieces.text: Starting Point is a four-week class on Wednesday nights about who we are and how to get connected. A new class begins {eventDate}, and dinner is on us.

pieces.heading: Foundations starts {eventDate}
pieces.text: Foundations is a six-week course on what Christians believe, how to read the Bible, and how to pray. It meets on Tuesday nights at Rock Solid {campus}.

pieces.heading: Student Camp registration is open
pieces.text: Students in grades 7 to 12 get a week of fun, friends, and Jesus. Register by {registerBy} to hold a spot.

pieces.heading: Pray for our students at camp
pieces.text: Our students leave for Student Camp on {eventDate}. Please pray for safe travel, good sleep, and open hearts.

pieces.heading: High schoolers: join a mission trip
pieces.text: Our high school students serve alongside a partner church for eight days. Applications are due by {registerBy}.

pieces.heading: VBS registration is open
pieces.text: Vacation Bible School is a week of songs, games, and Bible stories for kids from age 4 through grade 5. It starts {eventDate}, and spots fill fast.

pieces.heading: VBS needs crew leaders
pieces.text: Teens and adults can lead a crew, run a game, or serve snacks for one morning or the whole week. Training is quick, and the kids are a blast.

pieces.heading: New groups start {eventDate}
pieces.text: Small groups are where Sunday turns into friendship. Browse groups near you, from young adults to empty nesters, and join one this season.

pieces.heading: Host a group this season
pieces.text: If you can open your home and pour a cup of coffee, you can host a group. We'll give you a study and a coach.

pieces.heading: Serve Sunday is {eventDate}
pieces.text: Every team will have a table in the lobby after each service. Find a spot that fits your gifts and your schedule.

evergreen.heading: Find your people
evergreen.text: Life is better together. A small group is a few people who meet each week to talk, pray, and share a meal.

evergreen.heading: Make Sunday happen
evergreen.text: From parking to kids to coffee, there's a team for you. Most teams serve once or twice a month.

evergreen.heading: How can we pray for you?
evergreen.text: Our prayer team prays over every request by name each week. Share yours anytime.

evergreen.heading: Rock Solid in your pocket
evergreen.text: With the Rock Solid Church App you can watch live, take sermon notes, give, and find events. It's free for iPhone and Android.

evergreen.heading: Give from anywhere
evergreen.text: Set up a recurring gift online in just a few minutes. Your generosity helps us love God, love people, and share Jesus.

evergreen.heading: Kids love Sunday here
evergreen.text: Rock Solid Kids meets during every service for kids from birth through grade 6. Check in early on your first visit and we'll show you around.

evergreen.heading: Students, this is your place
evergreen.text: Students in grades 7 to 12 meet on Wednesday nights for worship, games, and small groups. Bring a friend this week.

evergreen.heading: Take your next step
evergreen.text: Not sure where to start? Tell us a little about yourself and we'll help you find your next step.

evergreen.heading: Watch online
evergreen.text: Traveling or home sick? Join us live on Sunday or catch any past message on demand.

evergreen.heading: Men, grab a seat
evergreen.text: Our men meet for breakfasts, service days, and a yearly retreat. Come for the food and stay for the friendship.

evergreen.heading: Women, you belong here
evergreen.text: Bible studies, nights out, and retreats are coming up for women of every age. Find one that fits your season.

evergreen.heading: Going through a hard season?
evergreen.text: You don't have to walk through it alone. Our care team can meet with you, pray with you, and help you find support.

evergreen.heading: What's on the calendar
evergreen.text: Classes, family nights, and serve days are happening across every campus. See what's coming up near you.

evergreen.heading: Everything Rock Solid {campus}
evergreen.text: Service times, directions, and your campus team are all in one place. Share the page with a friend you'd love to bring.

evergreen.heading: Thinking about baptism?
evergreen.text: Baptism is a way to tell the world you follow Jesus. If you have questions, we'd love to talk with you.

closings: We're so glad you're here. See you this weekend.
Love God. Love people. Share Jesus. See you soon!
Have a great week, and save us a seat on Sunday.
Thanks for reading. We're praying for you this week.
Grace and peace to you and your family.
If you have a question, just reply to this email. A real person will answer.
Bring a friend Sunday. There's always room for one more.
Stay cool out there, and we'll see you soon.
With love from your Rock Solid {campus} family.
